kgs.subject: Mathematics
kgs.as_bilingual_pair_policy: This Ghana Mathematics curriculum is English-only. Do not create bilingual pairs, translations, or cross-language duplicate candidates. Preserve visible English source text exactly. If non-English text appears incidentally, keep it only as source-visible text and do not translate it or pair it with an English candidate unless the document itself explicitly presents both versions as equivalent official curriculum text.
kgs.as_duplicate_review_instructions: Decide whether candidates in the bucket are the same Ghana curriculum item. Same official statement code with compatible text should merge. Same official statement code with conflicting text should be marked conflict. Similar text with different official codes should usually remain distinct.

kgs.as_repeated_statement_policy: Merge same official code when text is compatible. Same official code with materially conflicting text should become a conflict bucket.
kgs.as_sfi_extraction_instructions: Extract candidate StandardsFrameworkItems (SFIs) from the Ghana Mathematics curriculum only when the visible text is an official curriculum framework item or structural organizer within the target Basic 4–6 curriculum scope. Treat BASIC 4, BASIC 5, and BASIC 6 headings as Standard Grouping SFIs. Treat Strand headings and Sub-Strand headings as Standard Grouping SFIs when they are visible as curriculum organizers. Treat Content Standards with official Basic 4–6 codes such as B4.1.1.1, B5.1.1.1, or B6.1.1.1 as Standard SFIs. Treat Indicators with official Basic 4–6 codes such as B4.1.1.1.1, B5.1.1.1.1, or B6.1.1.1.1 as Standard SFIs. Do not extract KG1, KG2, B1, B2, or B3 codes, labels, sample rows, or annotation examples as SFI candidates when they appear in overview, organization, scope-and-sequence, annotation, or code-explanation sections. Those earlier-grade examples are explanatory context for the code system, not target Basic 4–6 curriculum items for this run. Do not extract LearningComponents in this step: do not decompose a content standard or indicator into smaller skills, concepts, lesson objectives, or teachable subskills. Treat exemplars, examples beginning with E.g., classroom activities, assessment suggestions, teacher guidance, resources, duration/time allocations, values, and pedagogical notes as auxiliary or non-SFI text, not SFIs. Treat Subject Specific Practices and Core Competencies as auxiliary guidance, not SFIs, unless a document-specific profile explicitly overrides this policy. Repeated table headers and repeated continuation labels are not SFIs. Preserve source-language wording. Use statement_code only when an official code is visible in the source window; preserve visibly malformed source codes in source_text and use a normalized statement_code only when the intended official Basic 4–6 code is clear from the visible source context.
kgs.lc_generation_instructions: Decompose each final Ghana Mathematics Standard SFI into one or more atomic mathematical skills or concepts. Do not create activities, examples, or assessment tasks as LearningComponents.
